caption: The drawing depicts a stoneware crock with a lid. The crock is cylindrical with slightly curved sides and has a beige or light brown color. It has two small, curved handles on each side near the top. The lid is a darker brown shade with a knob handle at the center. On the upper front part of the crock, there is blue stenciled text that reads "FROM E. L. FOWLER NEW LEBANON, NY." Below the text, there is a decorative blue design featuring symmetrical, semi-circular, and curved lines with small circular dots, and a single swirling line extending downward from the center of the design. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no other objects or details present.
title: Crock with Cover
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
